scenarios.title: Authorization PDF displays human-readable authorization URL
given: An authorization PDF is requested for a device
scenarios.when: The user views the generated authorization PDF
then: The PDF displays the authorization URL as readable text in addition to any QR code
The displayed URL is clear and legible for manual entry

scenarios.title: User successfully authorizes device by navigating directly to readable URL
given: An authorization PDF has been generated containing a human-readable authorization URL
The user accesses the authorization process from a laptop without scanning the QR code
scenarios.when: The user enters the readable authorization URL into a web browser on the laptop
then: The user lands on the device authorization screen
The user can complete authorization for the laptop

scenarios.title: Human-readable URL matches the destination in the QR code
given: An authorization PDF is generated containing both a QR code and a readable authorization URL
scenarios.when: The user inspects both the destination encoded in the QR code and the printed authorization URL
then: Both destinations point to the same device authorization target

scenarios.title: Full authorization URL is shown without truncation
given: An authorization session has a long URL containing identifiers or tokens
then: The complete authorization URL is shown without cut-off or hidden characters so all parts can be manually transcribed or copied

scenarios.title: Navigating to an expired readable authorization URL shows an invalid link message
given: The authorization session for the URL has expired or has already been used
scenarios.when: The user enters the readable authorization URL into a browser
then: The user is presented with a message indicating the authorization link is expired or invalid
